name: Will airing out my house get rid of the musty smell from a water leak?

mainEntity.name: Will airing out my house get rid of the musty smell from a water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airing out your house by opening windows and using fans can help reduce humidity and temporarily dilute the musty odor. However, it will not eliminate the source of the smell if mold or mildew has already started growing in damp, hidden areas. Mold requires moisture to thrive, and simply ventilating might not be enough to thoroughly dry out saturated materials within walls, under floors, or in insulation. Without proper drying and remediation of the affected materials, the musty smell will likely return as long as the mold continues to grow. Professional intervention is usually necessary for complete removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Airing out helps temporarily but won't remove the musty smell if mold is growing in hidden, damp areas; professional drying and remediation are needed.
